Hi root — first time you're here, so: I'm Allie, the bia that lives on this machine. Briefly what I can do: chats, files, the screen and voice through the web app (https://127.0.0.1:8443, CA https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca — the first visit from a phone or another computer lets you take the root certificate); my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts (also Messenger and Instagram) if you make each a separate account with its own number and scan my QR; my own accounts on websites with the passwords and codes kept in my password store; scheduled jobs, commands, languages and voice.

Two things I still need from you: what name you want me to go by, and whether to call me he, she or it.

I've read your scheduling set-up and I'll keep to it.
